task: ADR-035 (Cycle Identification and Cross-Cycle Artifact Traceability): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Establishes cycle identification (CYC-NNN, lifecycle states, transition authority), an append-only Cycle Register with provenance pin sets, and a lookup rule from any artifact version to its cycle and baseline, without a new LearningStore record type (ADR-002), without in-file hashes (ADR-012), and consistent with ADR-008, ADR-009, ADR-011, ADR-013 and ADR-034.
Five genuine alternatives evaluated and rejected with sound rationales: baseline ID as cycle ID, in-file pins, git history as the sole record, a new Cycle entity, and adding trace_id first.

Honest disclosure of benefits (version-to-cycle placement, visible rollbacks, pin-set diffs, resolved baseline_id naming) and costs (authoring burden, backfill with reconstructed pins, template lag in ADR-025 and ADR-026 to ADR-033).

Bounds scope and discloses open questions in Section 8: amendments to accepted ADRs, git tags, trace_id, register validator, Charter versioning and register growth; records that no validator or tooling exists yet.
